verdict.rationale: Rive documents exporting files to the .riv format, which its open-source runtimes can load, and RML, an XML text representation of Rive files, so some content can be carried out in openly readable form. There is no evidence of a bulk export of all account data or of a documented path off the platform, and the community notes that video and movie export is not offered. Missing for 10: bulk export of all files and data, documented RML export of existing files, export to widely interoperable formats such as video or SVG, and independent confirmation that exported data is usable without the Rive Editor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can use the same exported file across supported runtimes, including web, mobile, game engines, and other platforms.
The Rive runtimes are open-source libraries that allow you to load and control your animations in apps, games, and websites.
Rive Markup Language (RML) is a text-based representation of a Rive file.
